messages:
nina_sales: Zephyr Analytics sent back SIG v2 and marked Q5-Q8 as blockers for procurement. They want question-level artifacts + short plain-language answers by Thursday EOD. Can we split?

devon_se: I can take Q5 (logical tenancy & routing) and Q8 (network segmentation). Will need a redacted tenancy diagram and an Envoy YAML snippet.

sam_security: I'll own Q6 (KMS/key lifecycle) and Q7 (encryption at rest/in-transit). I have a rotation excerpt and an encryption practices note. Will attach.

leah_ps: I'll pull SOC2 excerpts, a short dataflow narrative, and a POC screenshot showing tenant filters.

uploaderbot: File uploaded: <https://files.redwood.internal/zephyr/tenancy_diagram_zephyr_v1.pdf|tenancy_diagram_zephyr_v1.pdf> (378KB)

devon_se: Drafting sanitized Envoy snippet (will redact hostnames before upload):
```yaml
# sanitized per-tenant routing example
virtual_hosts:
  - name: tenant-zephyr-demo
    routes:
      - match: /tenant/zephyr-demo/*
        cluster: rwinf-tenant-zephyr-demo
```

devon_se: Also include a one-line note on cache namespacing to show KV isolation. Example: `cache_namespace: rwinf_cache_tenant_zephyr_demo`

sam_security: For KMS: reference HSM-backed provider, automated rotations, and BYOK for Private deployments. I'll attach `kms_rotation_excerpt.md` and `byok_note.txt`.

leah_ps: Uploaded SOC2 excerpt and dataflow narrative: <https://files.redwood.internal/zephyr/soc2_excerpt_zephyr.pdf|soc2_excerpt_zephyr.pdf>, <https://files.redwood.internal/zephyr/dataflow_zephyr.md|dataflow_zephyr.md>

uploaderbot: File uploaded: <https://files.redwood.internal/zephyr/poc_tenant_filter_zephyr.png|poc_tenant_filter_zephyr.png> (120KB)

nina_sales: Excellent. Please paste the final shared filenames and a 1-2 sentence plain-English blurb per question so I can paste into their SIG answers (non-technical reviewers). Also confirm that all hostnames/account IDs will be redacted.

devon_se: Filenames: `/shared/sales-zephyr/tenancy_diagram_redacted.pdf`, `/shared/sales-zephyr/envoy_tenant_snippet.yaml`
devon_se: Plain English (Q5/Q8): "Traffic for each customer is routed using tenant-specific proxy rules that map to isolated runtime clusters and separate network segments; proxy rules and network policies prevent cross-tenant access."

sam_security: Filenames: `/shared/sales-zephyr/kms_rotation_excerpt.md`, `/shared/sales-zephyr/byok_note.txt`, `/shared/sales-zephyr/encryption_summary.txt`
sam_security: Plain English (Q6/Q7): "Encryption keys are stored in an HSM-backed KMS with automated rotation; data is encrypted in transit with TLS and at rest; Private deployments support customer-managed keys (BYOK)."

leah_ps: Filenames: `/shared/sales-zephyr/soc2_excerpt.pdf`, `/shared/sales-zephyr/dataflow_narrative.md`, `/shared/sales-zephyr/poc_tenant_filter.png`

leah_ps: Screenshot caption: "Runtime dashboard filtered to tenant 'zephyr-demo' showing request rate and error rate (no customer data)."

nina_sales: Perfect. Two small asks before I bundle: 1) ensure sample snippets have all hostnames/account IDs removed, 2) add a one-sentence verification note for the POC screenshot (what it demonstrates).

devon_se: Will redact hostnames/IDs and push sanitized files to the shared folder.
sam_security: Added rotation cadence line to KMS doc: "Rotation cadence: 90 days (automated); audit logs retained per retention policy."

nina_sales: Thanks all ":thumbsup:". I'll assemble the ZIP and send to Zephyr by Thu EOD. Ping here if anything changes.
